paper.title_en: Topology of Hawking-Page phase transition and equilibrium phases in AdS brane backgrounds
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the thermodynamic topology of the Hawking-Page transition and equilibrium black-hole branches for charged RN-AdS and rotating Kerr-AdS black holes localized on an AdS three-brane. Working in the grand canonical ensemble with the off-shell Bragg-Williams free-energy landscape, we show that the HP transition corresponds to a unique nondegenerate minimum with topological charge +1, while the small and large black-hole branches carry charges -1 and +1 and merge at minimum temperature into a zero-charge configuration. An analytical parameter-domain analysis confirms that varying the braneworld scale or angular velocity moves the defects without introducing additional bifurcation. The residue and vector-field prescriptions agree for nondegenerate branches. The unchanged charges indicate robustness, not a new topological class, within the analyzed spherical braneworld families, ensemble, and parameter domains.
